summary: Iter 59 — Agentic Orchestrator (Sovereign Intelligence Engine MVP-1) backend tests. 14/14 passed (100%). All 4-agent chain behaviors verified: cross-industry classification (real-estate/energy/startup), lead lock to founder, agent_runs persistence with full 4-step trace + asset_markdown + outreach, /list KPI, /detail edge cases, /run-on-lead reuse, business-activation auto-trigger (true→completes, false→no run), email graceful degrade without RESEND_API_KEY, outreach constraints (60-110 words, no banned phrases, signed 'Jeffrey · CreatorBoostAI').

minor.issue: Endpoint can be slow (>30s) when several long-running orchestrator runs are concurrently in-flight (4 Claude calls each). Not a correctness bug but consider adding background indexing on agent_runs.started_at and limiting fields fetched. First test run hit a 30s ReadTimeout on polling; resolved by raising client timeout to 60s + retry.

action_items: Optional: add a Mongo index on agent_runs.started_at desc to speed up /list under concurrent load.
Frontend dashboard surfacing of agent_runs is deferred per user direction — not in scope for this iteration.
Production: ensure RESEND_API_KEY is set so execution.email_sent flips to true (currently degraded by design in preview).
critical_code_review_comments: orchestrator.py:483 — /run endpoint is unauthenticated (auth_email/token are optional). Acceptable for MVP since it's not exposed in the UI yet, but lock down before public surface (rate-limit + founder gate).

orchestrator.py:142 — fallback when researcher returns non-JSON forces asset_type=icp_brief. Reasonable, but warning-only log; consider also persisting the parse failure into the run's steps array for audit.

orchestrator.py:265 — body_text rendered into HTML via straight string interpolation (no HTML escape on body_text). For founder-only personas this is fine, but if leads ever supply name/business_name through user input, this is an HTML/XSS injection vector inside the email render. Replace with html.escape(body_text) before interpolation.

business_activation.py:541 — asyncio.create_task(_orch(...)) is fire-and-forget; if the event loop is recycled or the task raises, there's no retry/dead-letter. For MVP this is acceptable, but log task.add_done_callback errors so silent failures are visible.
orchestrator.py:511 — /list excludes asset_markdown but full lead_input is returned (includes notes that may contain PII). Fine for founder-only feed but flag if exposed to wider audience.
orchestrator.py:518 — avg_duration_ms uses // and could divide by zero if no completed runs (guarded by max(1, ...) — OK).
seed_data_creation: Created 5+ TEST orchestrator runs (qa.iter59.<tag>.<rand>@example.com) and 2 business-activation captures. All under unique emails to avoid Lead Engine dedupe collisions. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter59_orchestrator.py. Each /run takes 25-50s (4 sequential Claude calls). Total suite runtime ~3.5-4 min. RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally absent in preview; production should re-verify email_sent=true. Auto-trigger polling uses up to 120s wait + retries on transient timeouts. If next iteration ships the frontend dashboard for agent_runs, add Playwright tests for /list rendering + /detail drawer.
rca of the issue: Single transient failure on first run was a client-side 30s ReadTimeout while polling /api/orchestrator/list during a window where 4 background orchestrator runs were concurrently calling Claude (compounding latency on the list aggregation). Not a server bug — bumped polling timeout to 60s and added retry-on-RequestException; second run was 100% green. Recommend adding a started_at index in MongoDB to harden /list under concurrent load.
